raw:
Zamira Orlworth was living in Brynby at the time Nynar Orlick died.  
Answer: Brynby.

The oak map belonged to Aeric Lindick, head of the Lindick household. According to the record, the oak map always passed, on the death of whoever held it, to the eldest living child of that holder. There is no information about who holds the oak map at the end of the record. 

Answer: unknown
Answer: the husband of Lulde Stenenridge

The garnet mirror was sent by Aeric Lindick to Tassa, who received it safely. Tassa then pressed the garnet mirror into the hands of Ilra Grimenridge and would take nothing for it. Ilra Grimenridge sent the garnet mirror by carrier to Ortho, who received it safely. Lulde Stenenridge won the garnet mirror from Ortho at cards, fairly, and kept it. Lulde pressed the garnet mirror into the hands of Tassa Corrley and would take nothing for it. 

Answer: Tassa Corrley.

The pewter comb was held by Ilmira Lindick immediately before its current holder, Thilis Stenenridge.  
Answer: Ilmira Lindick.

The glass chalice was held by Isrine Brackwood before it was pressed into the hands of Sedrek.  
Answer: Isrine Brackwood.

The pewter chalice was held by Isrine Brackwood before it was pressed into the hands of Sedrek by Isrine Brackwood.  
Answer: Isrine Brackwood.

The copper flute was held by Malan Stenenridge immediately before its current holder.  
Answer: Malan Stenenridge.

Tamira Orlick gave Neric Wexner a solemn promise to plant an orchard on the slope above Larkby.  
Answer: kept.

Elnelle Orlworth had been born in Stavegate.  
Answer: Stavegate.

Kara Corrley was born in Larkmere.  
Answer: Larkmere.

Neena Ashner was born at Kelwick.
Answer: Kelwick.
